'''Arl'Tokor''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|brown]]-spotted Cathar<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> with brownish-orange [[Hair/Legends|fur]], a brown mane, and orange eyes, they were one of many of their [[Species/Legends|species]] who settled on Taris. A fluent speaker of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Arl'Tokor wore heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for protection from the world's wildlife. They sold [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] and armor modifications from their shop in [[Olaris]], the headquarters of the Republic-sponsored [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arl'Tokor appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Mods Vendor for Republic players on Taris.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> they were removed from the game along with the rest of the Mods Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
